hook.convey: a jumper that always jumps the same size from 0 lands only on certain numbers → those landing spots are the number's multiples; the jumping never has to stop

use.hi: Ek chhota animal, mendhak, 0 se shuru karke hamesha 3 kadam ki chhalaang lagata hai. Woh har number par nahi girta, sirf kuch khaas numbers par. Aaj dekhenge ki woh kahaan-kahaan girta hai.
use.en: A small animal, a frog, starts at 0 and always jumps 3 steps. It does not land on every number, only on some special numbers. Today we see where it lands.

use.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. Har over ke baad ball ki ginti 6 se badh jaati hai. Yeh ginti ek khaas list banati hai, aur aaj hum us list ka naam seekhenge.
use.en: In cricket one over has 6 balls. After every over the ball count grows by 6. This count makes a special list, and today we learn the name of that list.

explain.convey: frog jumps 3 at a time from 0 → lands on 3, 6, 9, 12 → these landing spots = multiples of 3 = skip counting by 3

point.hi: Dekho, yeh rekha 3-3 ke kadam mein bani hai. Mendhak 0 se 3-3 ki chhalaang lagata hai, toh woh 3, 6, 9 aur 12 par girta hai. Yeh sab 3 ke multiples hain, yaani 3 ki skip counting mein jin numbers par hum pahunchte hain.
point.en: Look, this line is marked in steps of 3. The frog jumps 3 at a time from 0, so it lands on 3, 6, 9 and 12. These are all multiples of 3, that is the numbers we reach when we skip count by 3.

prompt.hi: Chaar chhalaang ke baad mendhak 12 par hai. Paanchvi chhalaang ke baad woh kis number par hoga?
prompt.en: After four jumps the frog is on 12. On which number will it be after its fifth jump?

why.hi: paanch chhalaang 3-3 ki hain, aur 5 × 3 = 15, yaani 12 ke baad 15
why.en: five jumps of 3 each make 5 × 3 = 15, the number after 12

simpler.hi: Mendhak 0 se shuru karke har baar 3 aage koodta hai: 3, 6, 9, 12. 3 ki ginti mein jin numbers par woh girta hai, woh 3 ke multiples hain.
simpler.en: The frog starts at 0 and jumps 3 on each time: 3, 6, 9, 12. The numbers it lands on when counting by 3 are the multiples of 3.

explain.convey: factors of 8 divide 8 exactly (1, 2, 4, 8); multiples of 8 come from skip counting by 8 (8, 16, 24, 32) and keep growing → two different lists

point.hi: Board par 8 ki do list hain. 8 ke factors 1, 2, 4, 8 hain, yeh 8 ko poora baant dete hain. 8 ke multiples 8, 16, 24, 32 hain, yeh 8 ki skip counting se aate hain aur badhte jaate hain.
point.en: The board has two lists for 8. The factors of 8 are 1, 2, 4, 8; they divide 8 exactly. The multiples of 8 are 8, 16, 24, 32; they come from skip counting by 8 and keep growing.

prompt.hi: 8 ke multiples wali list aage badhao. 32 ke baad 8 ka agla multiple kaunsa hai?
prompt.en: Continue the list of multiples of 8. What is the next multiple of 8 after 32?

why.hi: 8 ke multiples 8, 16, 24, 32 hain, aur agla 32 + 8 = 40 hai
why.en: the multiples of 8 go 8, 16, 24, 32, and the next is 32 + 8 = 40

simpler.hi: 8 ke factors 8 ko poora baantte hain: 1, 2, 4, 8. 8 ke multiples 8 ki ginti se aate hain: 8, 16, 24, 32, aur badhte jaate hain.
simpler.en: The factors of 8 divide 8 exactly: 1, 2, 4, 8. The multiples of 8 come from counting by 8: 8, 16, 24, 32, and they keep growing.

explain.convey: the jumper of 5 does not stop at 50: 50, 55, 60 … one more jump is always possible → a number has endless multiples

point.hi: Yeh mendhak 5-5 ki chhalaang lagata hai. 50 par pahunch kar bhi woh rukta nahi, 55 aur 60 par girta hai. Har baar ek aur chhalaang lag sakti hai. Isliye multiples ki list kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
point.en: This frog jumps 5 at a time. Even after reaching 50 it does not stop; it lands on 55 and 60. One more jump is always possible. So the list of multiples never ends.

prompt.hi: Yeh 5-5 wala mendhak aise hi koodta rahe, toh kya woh kabhi theek 100 par girega, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: If this frog keeps jumping 5 at a time, will it ever land exactly on 100, yes or no?

why.hi: 5 ki ginti 50, 55, 60 se aage badhti rehti hai aur 95 ke baad 100 par aati hai
why.en: counting by 5 goes on past 50, 55, 60 and comes to 100 right after 95

simpler.hi: Mendhak har baar 5 aage koodta hai, aur kabhi rukta nahi. Isliye 5 ke multiples ki list kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
simpler.en: The frog jumps 5 on every time and never has to stop. So the list of multiples of 5 never ends.

problem.hi: Rekha ki gullak khaali hai. Woh roz usme ₹7 daalti hai. Kya kisi din gullak mein theek ₹50 honge?
problem.en: Rekha's piggy bank is empty. Every day she puts ₹7 in it. Will there ever be exactly ₹50 in the piggy bank?

givens.hi: gullak shuru mein khaali hai aur roz ₹7 judte hain

find.hi: kya gullak mein kabhi theek ₹50 honge
find.en: whether the piggy bank ever holds exactly ₹50

why.hi: roz ₹7 judte hain, toh gullak mein hamesha 7 ka multiple hota hai
why.en: ₹7 is added each day, so the piggy bank always holds a multiple of 7

simpler.hi: Gullak mein roz 7 judte hain. Toh paise 7 ki ginti mein badhte hain: 7, 14, 21, aur aage 49 tak.
simpler.en: 7 is added to the piggy bank every day. So the money grows by counting in 7s: 7, 14, 21, and on up to 49.

why.hi: 49 mein 7 jodne se 56 banta hai
why.en: 49 plus 7 makes 56

simpler.hi: 49 ke baad agle din 7 aur judte hain. 49 aur 7 milkar 56 banta hai.
simpler.en: The day after 49, 7 more is added. 49 and 7 together make 56.

prompt.hi: Ab dono steps ki list dekho. Kya kisi din gullak mein theek ₹50 honge, haan ya nahi?

simpler.en: In the piggy bank, 49 is followed straight by 56. See whether 50 is in the list or gets skipped between these two.

why.hi: 7 ki ginti 42, 49 ke baad seedhe 56 par jaati hai, toh 50 chhoot jaata hai

answer.hi: gullak mein kabhi theek ₹50 nahi honge
answer.en: the piggy bank will never hold exactly ₹50

why.hi: 50, 49 aur 56 ke beech aata hai, aur 7 ki skip counting use chhod deti hai
why.en: 50 lies between 49 and 56, and skip counting by 7 jumps over it

use.hi: School garden mein ek plant ko ek bachcha har 4 din paani deta hai, aur ek doosra bachcha har 10 din. Aaj dono ne saath paani diya. Agli baar saath kab denge, yeh hum nikaalenge.
use.en: In the school garden one child waters a plant every 4 days, and another child every 10 days. Today both watered it together. We will work out when they next do it together.

explain.convey: bell A every 4 min, bell B every 6 min, ring together now → A: 4, 8, 12, 16; B: 6, 12 → together again after 12 min = the smallest common multiple

point.hi: Ghanti A har 4 minute par bajti hai: 4, 8, 12, 16. Ghanti B har 6 minute par: 6, 12. Dono abhi saath baji, aur agli baar 12 minute baad saath bajengi. 12, 4 aur 6 ka sabse chhota common multiple hai.
point.en: Bell A rings every 4 minutes: 4, 8, 12, 16. Bell B every 6 minutes: 6, 12. Both just rang together, and they ring together next after 12 minutes. 12 is the smallest common multiple of 4 and 6.

prompt.hi: 12 minute ke baad, yeh dono ghantiyan shuru se kitne minute par phir saath bajengi?
prompt.en: After the 12-minute mark, how many minutes from the start will these two bells next ring together?

why.hi: ghanti A ki list 20, 24 aur ghanti B ki 18, 24 tak jaati hai, toh 12 ke baad agla common 24
why.en: bell A's list runs to 20, 24 and bell B's to 18, 24, so after 12 the next common one is 24

simpler.hi: Ghanti A ke minute 4, 8, 12, 16 hain, aur ghanti B ke 6, 12. Dono mein pehle 12 aata hai, isliye dono 12 minute baad saath bajti hain.
simpler.en: Bell A's minutes are 4, 8, 12, 16, and bell B's are 6, 12. 12 comes first in both, so they ring together after 12 minutes.

explain.convey: bus every 8 min, bus every 12 min → lists start 8, 16, … and 12, … → the child continues both lists to the first common number; 8 × 12 = 96 is common but far later → add the smallest common multiple to the start time

point.hi: Bus 1 har 8 minute par chalti hai: 8, 16, aur aage. Bus 2 har 12 minute par: 12, aur aage. 8 × 12 = 96 bhi common hai, par hum 96 tak nahi rukte. Dono liston ko aage badhao aur pehla common number dhoondho.
point.en: Bus 1 leaves every 8 minutes: 8, 16, and on. Bus 2 every 12 minutes: 12, and on. 8 × 12 = 96 is also common, but we do not wait till 96. Continue both lists and find the first common number.

prompt.hi: Har 8 minute aur har 12 minute wali yeh dono bus 10:00 baje saath chali. Agli baar dono kitne baje saath chalengi?
prompt.en: These two buses, every 8 minutes and every 12 minutes, left together at 10:00. At what time will both next leave together?

why.hi: bus 1 ki list 8, 16, 24 aur bus 2 ki 12, 24 hai, toh 24 minute baad, 10:24 par
why.en: bus 1's list is 8, 16, 24 and bus 2's is 12, 24, so 24 minutes later, at 10:24

simpler.hi: 8 ki list aur 12 ki list, dono aage badhao. Jo number dono mein sabse pehle aaye wahi chahiye, 96 tak rukna zaroori nahi.
simpler.en: Continue both lists, for 8 and for 12. The first number in both is the one; there is no need to wait till 96.

problem.hi: Vikram school garden ko har 4 din paani deta hai aur Sana har 10 din. Dono ne 1 June ko saath paani diya. Agli baar dono kis date ko saath paani denge?
problem.en: Vikram waters the school garden every 4 days and Sana every 10 days. Both watered it on 1 June. On which date will they next water it on the same day?

givens.hi: Vikram har 4 din aur Sana har 10 din paani dete hain, aur 1 June ko dono ne saath diya
givens.en: Vikram waters every 4 days and Sana every 10 days, and both watered on 1 June

find.hi: agli date jab dono saath paani denge
find.en: the next date both water on the same day

do.hi: dono ke din likho, 4 ke multiples aur 10 ke multiples
do.en: Write both lists of days, multiples of 4 and multiples of 10

why.hi: har ek ka paani dene ka din uski gap ka multiple hota hai
why.en: each child's watering day is a multiple of their gap

simpler.hi: Vikram ke din 4 ki ginti se aate hain: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Sana ke din 10 ki ginti se aate hain: 10, 20.
simpler.en: Vikram's days come from counting by 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Sana's days come from counting by 10: 10, 20.

do.hi: dono liston ka pehla common number lo
do.en: Take the first common number of both lists

why.hi: 20 dono mein pehle aata hai, 4 × 10 = 40 baad mein
why.en: 20 comes first in both; 4 × 10 = 40 comes later

simpler.hi: Dono liston mein sabse pehle 20 aata hai. 4 × 10 = 40 bhi common hai, par woh baad mein aata hai.
simpler.en: 20 comes first in both lists. 4 × 10 = 40 is also common, but it comes later.

prompt.hi: Ab 1 June mein 20 din jodo. Kaunsi date aayegi?
prompt.en: Now add 20 days to 1 June. Which date is it?

simpler.hi: 1 June mein 20 din jodne hain. Date ke number 1 mein 20 milaao, wahi nayi date hai.
simpler.en: We need to add 20 days to 1 June. Add 20 to the date number 1; that is the new date.

why.hi: Vikram aur Sana ki list mein pehla common 20 hai, aur 1 June ke 20 din baad 21 June hai
why.en: the first common number in Vikram's and Sana's lists is 20, and 20 days after 1 June is 21 June

answer.hi: Vikram aur Sana agli baar 21 June ko saath paani denge
answer.en: Vikram and Sana next water the garden together on 21 June

why.hi: 20, 4 aur 10 ka sabse chhota common multiple hai, aur 1 June ke 20 din baad 21 June aata hai
why.en: 20 is the smallest common multiple of 4 and 10, and 20 days after 1 June is 21 June

prompt.hi: Diwali ki ek light har 6 second aur doosri har 15 second par jalti hai. Abhi dono saath jali. Kitne second baad dono phir saath jalengi?
prompt.en: One Diwali light flashes every 6 seconds and another every 15 seconds. Both just flashed together. After how many seconds will both flash together again?

why.hi: light 1 ki 6 second wali ginti aur light 2 ki 15 second wali ginti pehli baar 30 par milti hain
why.en: light 1's count of 6 seconds and light 2's count of 15 seconds first meet at 30

simpler.hi: 6 ki ginti aur 15 ki ginti, dono list likho. Jo number dono mein sabse pehle aaye, utne second baad dono saath jalengi.
simpler.en: Write both lists, counting by 6 and counting by 15. The first number in both is how many seconds until they flash together.

prompt.hi: Stand se ek bus har 12 minute aur ek auto har 18 minute par chalta hai. Dono 8:00 baje saath chale. Agli baar kitne baje saath chalenge?
prompt.en: A bus leaves the stand every 12 minutes and an auto every 18 minutes. Both left together at 8:00. At what time will they next leave together?

why.hi: bus ki 12 minute aur auto ki 18 minute wali ginti pehli baar 36 par milti hai, toh 8:36 par
why.en: the bus's count of 12 minutes and the auto's of 18 first meet at 36, so at 8:36

simpler.hi: 12 ki ginti aur 18 ki ginti likho, aur pehla common number dhoondho. Utne minute 8:00 mein jodo.
simpler.en: Write the counts by 12 and by 18, and find the first common number. Add that many minutes to 8:00.

prompt.hi: Ek ghanti har 5 minute aur doosri ghanti har 10 minute par bajti hai, aur abhi dono saath baji. Kya woh agli baar 50 minute baad hi saath bajengi, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: One bell rings every 5 minutes and another bell every 10 minutes, and both just rang together. Will they next ring together only after 50 minutes, yes or no?

why.hi: 10 khud 5 ka multiple hai, toh ghanti 1 aur ghanti 2 bas 10 minute baad saath bajti hain
why.en: 10 is itself a multiple of 5, so bell 1 and bell 2 ring together after just 10 minutes

simpler.hi: 5 ki ginti mein 10 bhi aata hai. Toh dekho dono ghantiyan sabse pehle kab saath bajti hain.
simpler.en: Counting by 5 also reaches 10. So see when the two bells first ring together.

ladder.why: predict before listing: jumpers 4 and 6 meet at 24 → no, at 12
bells every 6 and 9 minutes from 10: 00 → next together at 10: 18
far transfer: bus every 15, auto every 10 from 9: 00 → 9: 30
harder: displays every 8 and 14 minutes → 56 minutes → 9: 56

remediation.move: two timelines side by side, bell every 4 and bell every 6 → write both lists only until a number repeats → 12 comes before 24 → stop at the first match, not at the product

say.hi: Dono ki list saath likho aur pehla common number milte hi ruk jao. har 4 minute aur har 6 minute wali ghantiyan 12 minute par hi mil jaati hain, 24 tak rukna nahi padta.
say.en: Write both lists side by side and stop at the first common number. The 4-minute and 6-minute bells meet at 12 minutes already; we do not wait till 24.

simpler.hi: Dono list saath likho aur pehle common number par ruko. 4 minute aur 6 minute wali ghantiyan 12 par mil jaati hain, 24 tak nahi rukte.
simpler.en: Write both lists together and stop at the first common number. The 4-minute and 6-minute bells meet at 12; we do not wait for 24.

prompt.hi: Ek bus har 8 minute aur ek train har 10 minute par aati hai. Abhi dono saath aayi. Kitne minute baad phir saath aayengi?
prompt.en: A bus comes every 8 minutes, a train every 10. Both just came together. After how many minutes again together?

why.hi: bus ki 8 minute wali ginti 32 ke baad 40, aur train ki 10 minute wali bhi 40 par; pehla common 40
why.en: the bus's count of 8 minutes goes from 32 to 40, and the train's count of 10 also reaches 40 first

simpler.hi: 8 ki ginti aur 10 ki ginti, dono list likho. Jo number dono mein sabse pehle aaye, utne minute baad dono saath aayengi.
simpler.en: Write both lists, counting by 8 and counting by 10. The first number in both is how many minutes until they come together.
